snippet.title: HITMAN World of Assassination - The Host (ft. Jacksepticeye) Mission Briefing
snippet.description:
There are eyes everywhere, 47. Make sure they don’t see you. 👁️

Your target is controversial internet personality Finn Colton, better known by his online handle, Finnvictus.

The former children's television star is regularly criticized for exploitative contracts that push his employees to their limits. It’s time to take him offline. 📵

Play The Host featuring Jacksepticeye for FREE until November 25.

https://bit.ly/TheHost_GetNow

#TheHost #HITMAN #Agent47 #jacksepticeye

ABOUT IO INTERACTIVE IO 
Interactive is an independent videogame developer and publisher with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last two decades, IOI is dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences using their award-winning proprietary Glacier technology. IO Interactive has developed and published a reimagined James Bond origin story with 007 First Light and is currently developing a new IP under the codename Project Fantasy. For more information, visit: https://ioi.dk.
